name: WaterMedia Native Patch
description: Fixes WaterMedia FFmpeg on Android: replaces the glibc linux-arm64 natives with the android-arm64 (bionic) build of FFmpeg 8.0.1-gpl, preloads them into WaterMedia's extraction dir, and loads any .so dropped into <gameDir>/nativepatch/. Fixes 'dlopen failed ... in namespace clns-N'.
